title: Newton's Second Law for Center of Mass

variables.\\vec{A}_{\\text{cm}}: Acceleration vector of center of mass
variables.\\vec{F}_{\\text{net, ext}}: Vector sum of all external forces acting on system

assumptions: Internal forces obey Newton's Third Law in strong form
validity_conditions: Valid for closed systems of arbitrary internal complexity
common_misuse: Including internal forces (such as springs or explosion blasts) in F_ext
Assuming individual particles accelerate at A_cm
source_provenance: HCV1 Ch 9 p. 154 eq. 9.10; HRW Ch 9 p. 231; UP Ch 8 p. 287
